notes_for_editor: Confidence low. The only source that names this lookout is the Forest Lookouts listing, which gives the county and nothing else. The Komoot entry (Lookout Tower at Pine Island Harbor, St. James City) is a cycling viewpoint with no history; it is cited only to warn visitors and is not evidence about the Forest Lookouts tower. Whether the two are related is unverified, so do not merge them. The Pine Island Wikipedia article (read) covers the island and its fire control district, not a lookout tower. Neither the cached NHLR nor the cached FFLOS Florida index lists a Pine Island tower. Two searches found nothing on a Florida Forest Service tower here. The statewide WFTV quotes are context only and do not name this tower. Page reads: 4 (Pine Island listing, Firehouse article, Pine Island Wikipedia article, Komoot highlight).
